newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR East share offering to follow Tokai's offering.
newsitem.headline: JR East share offering to follow Tokai's offering.

text.p: JNR Settlement Corp said on Friday that it would decide on the timing of a further offering of shares in East Japan Railway Co (JR East) after offering shares in Central Japan Railway Co (JR Tokai).
JNR Settlement Corp also said that it will start selecting a lead manager for JR East's share offering.
The state-owned agent in charge of settling the debt and assets left by the Japanese National Railways (JNR) still holds 1.5 million JR East shares after having listed 2.5 million shares in 1993.
When the heavily indebted JNR was split into seven Japan Railway (JR) group companies in April 1987, the government inherited two thirds of JNR's debt, or 25.5 trillion yen.
The government had hoped to slash the debt by selling land left by JNR and listing state-owned shares of JR firms, but this has been delayed while interest payments have grown.
JR East and West Japan Railway Co (JR West), the two biggest spinoff firms, are the only members of the seven-strong JR group which are listed.
Tokai's listing is expected before the end of this year. JNR officials said the timetable has not yet been decided upon.
